exercise.name: Wall Sit
library_steps: Stand with your back flat against a wall, feet a step out in front.
Slide down until your thighs are level with the floor.
Keep your knees over your ankles and hold for the time.
exercise.one_line_summary: One held picture: back and head flat on a wall, thighs level with the floor, knees at 90 deg directly over the ankles, arms hanging.

setup.target: Hip-width, far enough from the wall that the shins are vertical at the bottom (ACE: 6-12 in to start, then slide down).
Whole back and back of the head on the wall.

movement.measure: hip flexion (held), thigh level with floor
tilt from vertical, knee over ankle

muscles.role: Hold the knee at 90 deg. Upright trunk + vertical tibia keeps demand on the knee extensors; quad EMG peaks near 90 deg knee angle.
Library secondary; hip extensor holding the hip at 90 deg with the trunk upright (lower hip moment than the knee).
Keep the back flat on the wall.

mistakes.mistake: Knees past the toes / feet too close
mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Shins slope forward, knees ahead of the toes.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Not the 90/90 position; more knee strain.
Much easier; not the exercise shown.

sources.citation: American Council on Exercise. 5 variations of the body-weight squat (wall squat).
sources.what_it_gave: Feet 6-12 in from the wall, slide down until thighs parallel, hold up to 30 s, whole back and head on the wall, right angle at the knees, knees in line with the ankles.

sources.citation: Straub RK, Powers CM. 2024. A biomechanical review of the squat exercise: implications for clinical practice. Int J Sports Phys Ther 19(4):490-501.
sources.what_it_gave: Upright trunk raises the knee flexion moment and lowers the hip moment; upright tibia lowers the knee moment; medium depth = 90-110 deg / thigh parallel.

sources.citation: Marchetti PH, da Silva JJ, Schoenfeld BJ, et al. 2016. Muscle activation differs between three different knee joint-angle positions during a maximal isometric back squat exercise. J Sports Med.
sources.what_it_gave: Isometric squat: quadriceps activity highest at 90 deg knee angle.

clip_check.check: Back and buttocks touching the wall, not inside it
